the X-ray and infrared data are powerful tools for identifying young stars, especially for those that are not massive.
the X-ray and infrared data sets have been combined in a novel and effective way to provide a large sample of young stars that is well suited for future studies.

, with the aid of the X-ray data, the MYStIX project has identified young stars with a reliability that is better than that obtained from any other method, including the use of spectral type and infrared excess alone.
